Abel liest die Nachricht zweimal. „Marta: Abel reads the note twice. "Marta didn't forbid me the craft. Only taking all the praise for myself." He fetches a new sign. "A public correction, or first a letter to her, with her name on every future piece? Both have to be honest."
Abel schneidet „Marta und Abel Kerbe“ in: Abel carves "Marta and Abel Kerbe" into the sign and adds correction slips to the invoices. "I should have bought the longer board sooner." As a reward he gives you his witness clamp. It strengthens your parry, but costs ten maximum health while worn.
Abel schreibt einen Brief mit einem Ante: Abel writes a letter with a share of his last wages and marks the new sign with both names. The old invoices stay as they are for now. He gives you his witness clamp: better parries, but ten less maximum health while you wear it.
Abel streicht Holzspäne vom freien Stuhl: Abel brushes wood shavings off the free chair. "Sit down. Whoever stands while trading easily mistakes their impatience for an opinion."
Abel pulls out a thin sample board. "My sister invented the ornamental letters everyone thinks are mine. When she moved away, I took on her commissions. I didn't leave her name under any of them."
Am trockenen Rand des Watts steckt eine: At the dry edge of the flats a tin bowl sits inside a second one. Between the bottoms the salt has preserved "Ida Rusk, net washer", while the outer writing is completely gone. A carved sentence reads: "The small bowl belongs to the neighbours." You take a copy, not someone else's property.
Auf der Tafel steht „Heller Grund“. Daru: The board reads "Bright Ground". Beneath it two family marks can be made out, a pot and a wheel. Hanne's old copy names only the wheel. A name for a shared workplace was recorded as if it belonged to a single family.
Auf der Werkbank ist nur ein heller Umri: On the workbench only a pale outline remains. Under the board it says "Bennet Siel, jetty mender", protected by a layer of resin. At every repaired spot you find his mark, two offset nails. You draw it next to the name, so that a memory doesn't become a mere list.
Auf einem ausgemusterten Kistenstempel l: Fresh soot lies on a discarded crate stamp. The small notch in the tower base has been struck again; its edges are bright. The handle bears Wanda's old work number, but this younger blow came from a different tool.
Bei Abel Kerbe entscheiden und den Lohn: Decide with Abel Kerbe and collect the reward.
Bei Hanne Mulde entscheiden und den Lohn: Decide with Hanne Mulde and collect the reward.
Bei Wanda Esse entscheiden und den Lohn: Decide with Wanda Esse and collect the reward.
Bring Sedge die Abschriften und bestimme: Bring Sedge the copies and decide how they are kept.
Das Probebrett trägt die Signatur „M. Ke: The sample board bears the signature "M. Kerbe" and a date before Abel's first workshop invoice. On the letter R the notch runs over the edge. The same flaw appears on Abel's younger tablets.
Der Griff liegt frei im Torf. Außen ist: The handle lies exposed in the peat. On the outside the name notch is empty; inside, a brass band keeps the carved words "Runa Vale, peat measure inspector" dry. Next to it, in the same hand: "The short bricks count double, the long excuses not at all." You copy the name and trade and leave the band in its place.
Der Stuhl ist leer, die Werkzeuge sind e: The chair is empty, the tools are packed. You have to be a member to have a say here. An empty shrine gives no tasks.
Die Innenseite des Schubkarrengriffs: The inside of the wheelbarrow handle
Die Karte zeigt Wandas ersten Abdruck oh: The card shows Wanda's first impression without a notch. Next to it lies the carbon copy of a return slip: the Lamp Office released the stamp as scrap without destroying the printing surface. Wanda's mark proves the manufacture, not the later use.
Compare the invoice with the R.
Die Werkstatt ist längst versunken, aber: The workshop sank long ago, but its name board lies at the peat cutting. A voluntary addendum from both families hangs by the stilt village jetty. Bring the texts together. I want to correct the old mistake without deciding for others again.
Druckfläche zerstören, Abdrücke aufheben: Destroy the printing surface, keep the impressions.
You wanted to ask me for something.
Ein Los, ein Gebot, ein Zuschlag. Danach:
One lot, one bid, one hammer. After that the member may ask for an ingredient. Whoever brought nothing may stay all the same.

We sell materials, formulas and returned things. A remembered name is witnessed, not acquired. No one can buy a claim to a person at auction here.

Beneath the last line it says: "Not against a receipt either."
Ein frischer Holzspan liegt in deiner Ma: A fresh wood shaving lies in your coat pocket. The Tablet Guild opens the dry shrine beneath the stilt village. The meeting place is now on the city map.
Eine Rechnung wirbt mit „eigenem Schrift: An invoice advertises "own lettering design, A. Kerbe". In the margin the sample R, overrunning notch and all, is rubbed in. An enclosed note from his sister expressly permits the use, but demands her name next to his.
Eine Spule aus Moorholz bewahrt den Atem: A spool of moor wood keeps the breath between two calls. Thoughts grow calmer, but foreign light grows sharper.
Eine ausgemusterte Matrize liegt bei den: A discarded die lies among the old crates at Buoy Harbour. Someone struck my mark again. Compare the impression with the maintenance card at the peat cutting before we destroy the wrong piece.
Remind me where they were found.
Geschützt in der Lade. Keine Liste für d: Protected in the chest. No list for the Office.
Hanne befestigt die berichtigte Abschrif: Hanne fastens the corrected copy next to the old board. "Whoever learns from us should see our mistakes too." She gives you a formula of the Echo from her teaching box. "A voice can be passed on without registering its owner."
Hanne dreht einen Becher um. „Meinen ers: Hanne turns a cup over. "I made my first entry twice. Two families wanted the same name for their shared workshop, and I wrote one of them out. I created order and a feud along with it."
Hanne legt die beiden Zeichen nebeneinan: Hanne lays the two marks side by side. "This time everyone agreed. The original can tell of our mistake here or go into the moor at the remembrance. The copies stay with the families, and I'll write both names in."
Hanne stellt drei Becher hin, obwohl nur: Hanne sets out three cups, though only you stand before her. "One for the guest, one for me, one for someone who doesn't dare yet."
Hanne wickelt die Tafel für das gemeinsa: Hanne wraps the board for the shared remembrance and enters both families in her book. "The moor gets wood. No one gets a person." She leaves you a formula of the Echo from her teaching box, while the copies stay with the families.
Helles Harz aus versunkenem Holz. Wanda: Pale resin from sunken wood. Wanda uses it to protect legible traces from salt. Not a new potion formula.
Ich habe die drei Namen samt ihren Spure: I have the three names and their traces.
Her sample board still hangs in the stilt village. My first invoice lies at the Salt Market. Compare the two. I want to know whether I only borrowed her flourish or sold her work as well.
In der Lade liegen die Abschriften für R: The chest holds the copies for Runa Vale, Bennet Siel and Ida Rusk with their find sites. Whoever knows something about a name may read and add to it here. The complete list stays in the shrine.
Lies die geschützte Schrift im Torfstich: Read the protected writing at the peat cutting.
Mutter Sedge bürgt für dich bei der Täfe: Mother Sedge will vouch for you with the Tablet Guild if you bring back three names swallowed by the moor from their remaining traces. No one has to give up their own for it.
Offen bewahren. Die Nachbarn sollen mitr: Keep them open. The neighbours should have a say.
Keep the original at the shrine.
Original beim Gedenken dem Moor schenken: Give the original to the moor at the remembrance.
Keep the original sealed as evidence.
Runa Vale, Bennet Siel und Ida Rusk steh: Runa Vale, Bennet Siel and Ida Rusk stand on three copies. Next to them is room for their neighbours' memories. Someone has already added "gave away the better bowl" by Ida.
Sedge lifts three empty holders from the floor. "Runa, Bennet, Ida. I still know someone was there, but the moor took the rest. Look for the handle at the peat cutting, the workbench here and the double bowl at the way into the flats."

"Don't bring guessed names. If you bring their traces back, I'll vouch for you with the Tablet Guild."
Sedge hängt die Abschriften in geschützt: Sedge hangs the copies in protected frames. "I'll vouch for you. Beneath the stilt village lies our dry shrine. You'll find it on the city map as soon as our round opens." She slides travel money over to you. "Memory is priceless. Your shoes, unfortunately, are not."
Sedge legt die Abschriften in eine Lade: Sedge lays the copies in a chest and writes the find sites on the lid. "Whoever asks may look. No one may take the list away." She gives you travel money and names the shrine beneath the stilt village. "I'll vouch for you. The meeting place appears on the city map when the round opens."
Sedge liest Namen, Berufe und Zeichen zu:
Sedge reads the names, trades and marks together. "Now they have neighbours again, not just letters." She lays out two cords.

"Open at the shrine, so everyone can add to the stories? Or in the guild chest, where the Lamp Office won't copy them? Both keep them, but in different ways."
Sichere den Namen unter der Werkbank im: Secure the name under the workbench in the stilt village.
Staub aus unbeschrifteten Täfelchen. Abe: Dust from unlettered tablets. Abel uses it with resin to fill old notches. Not a new potion formula.
Sumpfminze und Honig, in Papier mit leer: Bog mint and honey, in paper with an empty name field. Restores 6 health and lowers unrest by 12. It does not give back a lost name.
Trockener Schrein unter Pfahldorf. Namen: Dry shrine beneath the stilt village. Bear witness to names, trade in returned things. Members only, during an open meeting.
Vergleiche die beiden Schalen im Salzwat: Compare the two bowls on the salt flats.
Wanda hält den linken Daumen unter der S: Wanda keeps her left thumb under her apron. "I made the first die myself. Back then it was only meant to count oil cans. When I see the shape, I remember my wages very precisely."
Wanda kreuzt die Druckfläche mit zwei ti: Wanda crosses the printing surface with two deep cuts. "Now no one can count what isn't theirs with it any more." She gives you a sealed sample of moor resin and notes your help for the guild price.
Wanda legt den Hammer auf ein gefaltetes: Wanda lays the hammer on a folded cloth. "Here we bid, we don't command. For commands we have a whole office up top."
Wanda legt den Stempel unter zwei Siegel: Wanda places the stamp under two seals. "Evidence is a tool you distrust. I can handle both." She gives you a sample of moor resin and notes your help for the guild price.
Wanda vergleicht deine Abreibungen. „Das: Wanda compares your rubbings. "The piece is mine, the new blow isn't. I can make the die unusable and keep both impressions. Or we secure the original as evidence; then a usable stamp also stays in the cupboard."
Wann öffnet der Schrein der Gilde?: When does the guild's shrine open?
Warm broth of barley and salt herbs. Restores 18 health and lowers unrest by 6. The spoon is not included in the price.
Was bedeutet das Ende am Turm für euch?: What does the ending at the tower mean for you?
Was behältst du für dich?: What do you keep to yourself?
Was hältst du vom Lichtamt?: What do you think of the Lamp Office?
Wer bewahrt die Täfelchen, wenn du nicht: Who keeps the tablets when you no longer carve?
Wie kamst du zu diesem Handwerk?: How did you come to this craft?
Wo sollte ich die drei Namen suchen?: Where should I look for the three names?
Zuerst Marta schreiben, künftig gemeinsa: Write to Marta first, sign together from now on.
Zwei eiserne Backen halten ein unbeschri: Two iron jaws hold a blank piece of wood. Under pressure your hand stays still, but the body bears the load.
Zwei erwachsene Nachkommen haben mit Top: Two adult descendants have signed with pot and wheel. "Both families should be named. Whether the old board stays in the shrine or is given to the moor at the next remembrance, we leave to the guild. We keep a copy either way."
Öffentlich berichtigen, auch die alten R: Correct it publicly, the old invoices too.
„Brandt sitzt ein. Die Klammern ihrer Li: "Brandt is locked up. The clamps of her lists are still the same. I forge new ones, and this time anyone can check what lies between them." Wanda puts ordinary lamp oil next to the hammer.
„Dann bauen wir höhere Stege. Namenstäfe: "Then we'll build higher jetties. Name tablets don't replace beams, but beams don't remember anyone either." Wanda counts nails instead of culprits.
„Das Amt fragt nach sauberer Schrift. Ic: "The Office asks for clean lettering. I ask who is meant to read it. A name that only appears on a list keeps bad company."
„Das Lichtamt will Namen vor der ersten: "The Lamp Office wants names before the first meal. I insist on the meal. It's hard to negotiate about order with a hungry child."
„Das Lichtamt wollte alle alten Werkzeic: "The Lamp Office wanted to replace all the old work marks with numbers. A number fits on any crate. That's exactly what makes it so convenient when someone carries off the wrong one."
„Das Musterbrett zuerst, dann Die Rechnu: "The sample board first, then the invoice with the R. Without both traces we decide nothing." Abel Kerbe lays an empty sheet in front of you. "The copies stay with you, even if you have to leave in between."
„Dein Name passt auf ein Brett wie jeder: "Your name fits on a board like any other. I won't carve it bigger just because it now stands under orders." Abel pushes the price board towards you, not his hand.
„Dein Siegel macht die Menschen in deine: "Your seal doesn't turn the people on your lists into fuel." Wanda stays at the table, the hammer under her hand. "We keep our word here. You can't buy applause at auction."
„Der kalte Abdruck zuerst, dann Die Wart: "The cold impression first, then the maintenance card. Without both traces we decide nothing." Wanda Esse lays an empty sheet in front of you. "The copies stay with you, even if you have to leave in between."
„Die Kinder werden höhere Schuhe brauche: "The children will need higher shoes. And adults who tell them honestly why." Hanne folds a blanket. "I'm glad about the freed lights. I'm still afraid of the sinking house."
„Die Ruftafel der Werkstatt zuerst, dann: "The workshop's name board first, then the descendants' addendum. Without both traces we decide nothing." Hanne Mulde lays an empty sheet in front of you. "The copies stay with you, even if you have to leave in between."
„Die Werkstatt ist längst versunken, abe: "The workshop sank long ago, but its name board lies at the peat cutting. A voluntary addendum from both families hangs by the stilt village jetty. Bring the texts together. I want to correct the old mistake without deciding for others again."
„Du bist fortgekommen. Die anderen wache: "You got away. The others still wake up under the same light." Wanda puts an unused ticket nail aside. "If you come back, bring hands for working."
„Du findest sie ohne das Lichtamt“, sagt: "You'll find them without the Lamp Office," says Sedge. "And without taking anyone's name away. That's the part the gentlemen like to skip."
„Ein Freispruch ist eine gute Zeile. Dar: "An acquittal is a good line. Beneath it belong the names of those who never got one." Abel keeps carving slowly, without belittling the verdict.
„Eine ausgemusterte Matrize liegt bei de: "A discarded die lies among the old crates at Buoy Harbour. Someone struck my mark again. Compare the impression with the maintenance card at the peat cutting before we destroy the wrong piece."
„Heute haben zwei Eltern gefragt, ob sie: "Today two parents asked whether they may finally give their children a name without registration. I put water on first." Hanne smiles. "Brought to court is a beginning, not an end to our work."
„Ich helfe Kindern in die Welt und ihren: "I help children into the world and their parents to a name. The children may disagree later. For that we keep a second, rather thick book."
„Ich schmiede Klammern für Holz, das ält: "I forge clamps for wood older than my workshop. My father called it patchwork. His anvil now stands on my patches."
„Ich schnitze Namen so, dass Regen sie l: "I carve names so that rain can read them and still leave them standing. For long names I take wider boards. Cheaper than arguing with the parents."
„Ich schreibe keinen Namen für deine Sam: "I won't write down a name for your collection trips. Not even one whose family you don't know." Hanne leaves the third cup empty. "An empty place is not an order."
„Ich verstehe, dass du leben wolltest. D: "I understand that you wanted to live. So do the people here." Hanne covers the remaining cup. "If you come back, we can talk. Your departure didn't stop Brandt."
„Im Pfahldorf hängt noch ihr Musterbrett: "Her sample board still hangs in the stilt village. My first invoice lies at the Salt Market. Compare the two. I want to know whether I only borrowed her flourish or sold her work as well."
„Im Torfstich der alte Schubkarrengriff:
"At the peat cutting, the old wheelbarrow handle by the cutting trench. Here in the village, the workbench west of my stool. On the salt flats two bowls lie one inside the other, right at the landward entrance."

Sedge taps your notebook. "Take along what the name was attached to. On paper, I mean. My room is full enough."
„In unserer Lade steht dein Name noch be: "In our chest your name still stands among the living. That's good." Abel lays an empty sheet next to it. "What stands beneath your deeds remains incomplete all the same."
„Jetzt fragen alle nach Täfelchen. Ich v: "Now everyone asks about tablets. I don't promise them forty safe years." Abel checks the grain. "I only promise not to write anyone wrong on purpose."
„Wenn nach den Lichtlosen und den Salzbr: "When our round comes after the Lightless and the Salt Brothers, the dry shrine beneath the stilt village opens. The city map only shows it during the meeting." Sedge picks up a wood shaving. "When the auction is over, stay for conversation. If you leave, you'll get back in at the next round."
